second_order: finding and relocating where to build
theme_note: These codes all locate the shared work so people can reach it: coordinates, landmarks, references, moves, and checking what is already down vary within that locating practice.

second_order: joining in and keeping the pixel work moving
theme_note: These passages recruit or join the build and keep its immediate work moving; participation ranges from bringing another account to correcting widths, thanking locators, and taking up a pictured plan.

second_order: adding and revising what goes around the ND
theme_note: These codes propose, sequence, draw, or revise the outline, words, colors, flags, lattice, numbers, and borders around the monogram; what varies is the desired addition and whether it remains a proposal or becomes pixel work.

Across otherwise different exchanges, people respond to collisions by apologizing, moving, trading help, honoring prior work, or sharing a boundary so both projects can remain; the contested object and the bargain vary.

second_order: deciding whether to attack other school images
theme_note: These codes act on or debate attacks on Michigan and USC imagery; they range from placing a dot or calling for replacement to warning of retaliation and refusing escalation.
These passages turn from making to holding the image: calling for defense, limiting it to their own spot, redirecting helpers, and repairing damage vary within the practice.

second_order: moving coordination into Discord and bringing plans back
theme_note: These codes seek more coordination, recruit Discord organizers, and return a Discord-made GCND proposal to Reddit; what varies is whether talk is leaving, being organized there, or coming back as a plan.
These passages mark a full logo, say they did it, cheer, declare ND won, and congratulate one another; the milestone varies from completion during the event to retrospective victory.
One participant challenges the claim of winning and another jokingly defines the event as a test of the strongest subreddits; together they negotiate the meaning of the celebration.

second_order: being haunted by the red dot
theme_note: This single code stands alone because the post-event recollection of the red dot is neither defense in progress nor the exchange about what winning meant.
